scene.note: Every quote now ends one of two ways, a price or a reason, and the reason is written once, at the end of the chain.

steps.note: The poster count arrives, and the step checks it against the 100 sheets asked for.
There are not enough, so the step throws.
then() catches the throw and fails its next docket with it, so the script does not crash and the other quotes go on.
A failed quote reaches catch(), which is then() with only a handler for failures.
The handler turns the reason into a sentence saying why there is no quote tonight.
What the handler returns keeps the next docket, so the chain carries on and the line is printed.
The napkin count fails at once: there is no line for napkins.
The steps after it have nothing to do with a failure, so each passes it on unchanged and runs nothing.
The failure reaches the first handler that takes it, at the end, and the line says why.
